_doc: Shared atlas tool-mandate contract. Read by hooks/bash_advisor.py + hooks/session_boot.py (Claude Code) and omp/mandates.ts (omp). Edit here, never per harness.
commitNudge: [atlas mandate] Before this commit, run ponytail-review (less-code review) on the staged diff (`git diff --cached`): delete what the change does not need, then commit. Nudge only; it fires once per session (ATLAS_MANDATES=off disables).
recall: Recall first: before planning or asking the user to re-explain prior work, run one claude-mem search for this project ({route}, then timeline/get_observations on hits). ATLAS_MANDATES=off disables this line.
recallGate: [atlas gate] REQUIRED once per session: your first tool call must be one claude-mem recall for this project ({route}). {example} Every other tool call (TodoWrite and ToolSearch excepted) is denied on every attempt until you make it; then continue. ATLAS_MANDATES=off disables it.
recallGateExample: Example search args: {"query": "<prior work on this project>"}

recallGateCases._doc: Tool calls the recall gate classifies; asserted by omp/mandates.test.ts and hooks/test_recall_gate.py. name = Claude Code tool name, ompName = omp tool name when it differs. satisfy: a real claude-mem call (allowed, and the only thing that satisfies the gate; it counts even if the call then errors). block: denied on every attempt until a satisfy call happens in the session. exempt: neither denied nor satisfying. Never gated, by the hook rather than by a case: subagent calls (agent_id or /subagents/ transcript), Claude Code ToolSearch (it loads the deferred recall tool), and sessions with no claude-mem tool mounted (allowed, traced once via atlas_faults).
